# Service Agreement

> Template only, **not legal advice**. Adapt it to your country and have a lawyer review it once.
> Fill everything in [brackets]. Send it for e-signature (Zoho Sign, DocuSign, PandaDoc, Adobe Sign) and put the link in
> `onboarding.contract_link`.

**Between:** [Your name / business], [address], [GSTIN/Tax ID if any] ("Service Provider")
**And:** [Client legal name], [address], [GSTIN/Tax ID if any] ("Client")
**Date:** [date]

## 1. Scope of work
The Service Provider will deliver: [e.g. a mobile-friendly one-page website with online booking connected to the
Client's Google Calendar, contact form, basic on-page SEO].

## 2. Deliverables
| # | Deliverable | Format |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Homepage design] | [Figma link / live preview] |
| 2 | [Built website] | [live on client domain] |
| 3 | [Short handover video] | [Loom] |

## 3. Not included
[Copywriting beyond provided text, paid ads, logo design, hosting fees, third-party subscriptions, content updates after handover, ...]
Anything not listed in sections 1–2 is out of scope and will be quoted separately.

## 4. Timeline
Work starts after (a) this agreement is signed, (b) the first payment is received, and (c) the access listed in
section 7 is provided. Expected delivery: [N working days] from that point. Delays caused by late feedback or access
extend the timeline accordingly.

## 5. Revisions
[2] rounds of revisions are included per deliverable. A round = one consolidated list of changes sent within [5] working
days of a delivery. Further rounds are billed at [rate].

## 6. Fees and payment terms
- Total fee: **[amount + currency]** [+ GST/VAT as applicable]
- Payment schedule: [50%] on signing, [50%] on delivery, before go-live/handover.
- Payment method: [bank transfer / UPI / Razorpay / Stripe link]. Invoices are due within [7] days.
- Late payments: work pauses until the balance is cleared.

## 7. Client responsibilities
The Client will provide within [3] working days of kickoff: [domain/hosting access as user invite, Google Business
Profile manager access, logo and brand files, text and photos], and one point of contact who can approve work.
Passwords must not be shared over chat or email; access is given as user invitations wherever possible.

## 8. Communication
Main channel: [email thread / project portal]. Response time: within [1–2] working days. Meetings by appointment.

## 9. Ownership
On full payment, the Client owns the final deliverables. The Service Provider may show the work in its portfolio
unless the Client objects in writing. Third-party assets (fonts, plugins, stock images) remain under their own licences.

## 10. Confidentiality
Both parties keep the other's non-public information confidential during and after this agreement.

## 11. Cancellation
Either party may end this agreement with [7] days' written notice. The Client pays for work completed up to that date;
payments already made for completed milestones are non-refundable.

## 12. Liability
The Service Provider's total liability is limited to the fees paid under this agreement. No liability for indirect
losses, or for issues caused by third-party services (hosting, plugins, payment gateways).

## 13. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of [country/state]; courts of [city] have jurisdiction.
